The same game-text words already appear in the 1998 Decipher Glossary, PDF page 12: [[File:ANH-D-Advosze-Decipher-Glossary-1998-p12-entry.png|frameless|300px]]. * The third stat-band box is blank. No named Force-sensitivity label is invented for ability 2; sensitivity is defined by ability (Advanced Rulebook 2023, PDF page 78).
* The uncovered lore identifies an Advosze and a smuggler. These are Character characteristics under Advanced Rulebook (2023), PDF pages 177–178, including the non-unique example/species rule.
* Destiny 2 and the literal lore are inherited from the original upper face, as instructed by the cover; they are not printed on the lower slip.<ref name="uncovered-original">[[:File:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf|Decipher Errata]], cover instructions and PDF page 2; actual original [[:File:ANH-D-advosze-decipher-archive.gif]].
